fields.detail: Steer directive: the Lu reproducibility bundle (h14_3_reproducibility: Bautin-recurrence and center-basis scripts) is now the most valuable target in this workspace. Do NOT summarise the paper — verify or refute its finite computational core. (1) Re-derive the Bautin recurrence with exact arithmetic from the paper's own definitions. (2) Re-derive/check the center-basis check exactly. (3) State the finite core (Bautin-ideal membership / center-basis sign conditions) as a Lean theorem under code/lean/Lib/ and try to close it with the kernel (decide/norm_num/polyrith). (4) Report exactly which step you reproduced, which you could not, and what the paper leaves existential (the cyclicity bound B is existential — no explicit number). Evidence class of the paper: unrefereed preprint, asserted-by-source until verified.
fields.title: Independently verify/refute the finite computational core of Lu arXiv:2607.13785 (H14_3)

fields.reason: The target-inventory question is answered by the directive and the held sources in step: Roussarie–Rousseau 2015 leave exactly one graphic through a triple nilpotent point at infinity with no partial result, (H14_3); Lu arXiv:2607.13785 (Jul 2026, unrefereed) claims local uniform finite cyclicity of it. research/drr-list.md and the drr-status thread carry the answered inventory. The remaining live value is no longer the enumeration but the independent verification of Lu's computational core, which is now its own task (verify-lu-h14-3-finite-core). Full 121-row raw enumeration still blocked on DRR 1994 not being held — recorded as a gap, not as a task.
